name: KtglTokenHandlerTable
description: KTGL command-stream token handler table (185 entries, u16 token id); replayed by SynergisticDispatcherLoop 1A7C3E0 and 495EFC

name: EclTokenHandlerTable
description: ExecuteCommandListsThread token table: tok6 ExecuteCommandLists(1 list), tok7 queue Signal, tok8 queue Wait, tok0/3 other queue vfns +0x30/+0x48

name: SynPsoFlushFunctorVtbl
description: one-entry functor vtable (slot0 = SynFlushPsoAndBindings 118604) invoked per draw from SynFlushGfxStateForDraw 1180D0

name: GfxDeviceVtbl_PresentSlot
description: graphics-device vtable slot holding GfxDevicePresentVfn 5DA94 (slot-0x10 = RenderFrameBegin 4A529C, slot-8 = 4A3334); vtable start not determined

name: g_DispatcherDrainBusy
description: last result of DispatcherRingBusy written each iteration of WaitDispatcherDrainSpin 418F40; only referenced there

name: g_PresentPreHook
description: optional callback called right before swapchain Present (present thread 1A82298 and inline path in 3D62E4); likely latency-marker hook

name: g_PresentPostHook1
description: optional callback after Present returns (1A82298, 3D62E4); likely latency marker

name: g_PresentPostHook2
description: second optional callback after Present returns (1A82298, 3D62E4)

name: SynergisticDispatcherLoop
description: SynergisticDispatcherTask body: WaitForSingleObject(sem, INFINITE), pop 32-B ring item, replay tokens via KtglTokenHandlerTable into SynCtx+0x580 command list, on submit items close list (496078) and hand to ECL ring (4930C8); 60 % CPU, 44 % blocked

name: SynergisticDispatcherThreadEntry
description: thread entry: SetThreadDescription SynergisticDispatcherTask then SynergisticDispatcherLoop

name: ExecuteCommandListsThreadEntry
description: thread entry: SetThreadDescription ExecuteCommandListsThread then ExecuteCommandListsThreadLoop 1A75970

name: ExecuteCommandListsThreadLoop
description: waits on ECL semaphore, replays ECL token items (EclReplayTokens 4F9054), then EclItemDone 2526E4; 2-4 % CPU mostly kernel

name: EclReplayTokens
signature: void (ID3D12CommandQueue* q, u16** stream, u8 flag)
description: replays one ECL item through EclTokenHandlerTable 3BD4DF0

name: EclTokExecuteCommandList
description: ECL tok6: queue->ExecuteCommandLists(1, &list) (vtbl+0x50); one list per call, ~28 GFX lists per frame

name: EclTokQueueSignal
description: ECL tok7: queue->Signal(fence, value) (vtbl+0x70)

name: EclTokQueueWait
description: ECL tok8: queue->Wait(fence, value) (vtbl+0x78)

name: EclItemDone
description: after an ECL item: ++completed, ReleaseSemaphore(r+8), --pending

name: PresentThreadEntry
description: thread entry of the (unnamed) present thread -> PresentThreadLoop

name: PresentThreadLoop
description: waits on GfxDevice+0x7720, calls swapchain(+0x7730)->Present(+0x7738, +0x773C) (vtbl+0x40) between g_PresentPreHook/PostHooks, then clears +0x7728; Present path is SL -> RTSS OSD -> Steam overlay -> dxgi

name: GfxDevicePresent
description: end of frame on the main thread: CmdStreamEndFrame 418B94 (final kick + drain spin), ResolveQueryData on list +0x590, back buffer -> PRESENT barrier (115E24 on device+0x10), GfxSubmitFrameCmdList 252758, then either inline Present (+0x3F80 == 0) or wait previous present (7D9E90) + SetEvent to the present thread; stores its QPC duration in +0x7708

name: GfxDevicePresentVfn
description: graphics-device vtable method (via thunk 5DA8C): pre-present bookkeeping then tail-jumps to GfxDevicePresent 3D62E4

name: WaitPresentThreadIdle
description: `while (d+0x7728) Sleep(0)`: waits until the present thread has RETURNED from Present (flag cleared at 1A822D9); 1-6.1 % of main thread; W6 (was SpinWaitFlagSleep0 / SubmitWaitSpin: it waits for the Present thread, not the submit thread)

name: RenderFrameBeginWaitPresent
description: frame-begin: if +0x3F80 wait WaitPresentThreadIdle, PagePoolFrameUpdate 252510, GetCurrentBackBufferIndex (swapchain +0x4278 vtbl+0x120) -> back-buffer RT from +0x4698[], CmdStreamBeginFrame 7D9C78 (was WaitSubmitThread: it waits for the Present thread)

name: CmdStreamBeginFrame
signature: bool (GfxDevice* d, void** backBufferRt, void* p3)
description: starts the frame's KTGL command stream at +0x3C40 (buffer from +0x2538) with the current back buffer

name: CmdStreamEndFrame
description: CmdStreamFinalKick 418C70 then snapshots and clears the per-frame stream stats block +0x3C78..+0x3CF8 into +0x3D00

name: CmdStreamFinalKick
description: pushes the last stream segment to the dispatcher ring with submit=1 (DispatcherRingPush 25426C), then WaitDispatcherDrainSpin 418F40, then resets the stream pointers

name: WaitDispatcherDrainSpin
description: pure busy spin (no pause/Sleep) until DispatcherRingBusy returns 0, i.e. the dispatcher has consumed everything; 0.7-2.1 % of main thread; patch S1 adds PAUSE (was MainHot_418F40)

name: DispatcherRingBusy
description: returns write != read (+0x24/+0x28) or inflight (+0x30) > 0

name: DispatcherRingPush
signature: void (DispatcherRing* r, StreamSeg* seg, u8 submit, Stats* s)
description: push a 32-B item {ctx, begin, end, submit} into the dispatcher ring, lock inc inflight, ReleaseSemaphore

name: KtglCmdStreamFlush
description: kick: pushes stream segment [+0x3C48, +0x3C40) to the dispatcher ring at +0x3BE0 (inline ring push + ReleaseSemaphore); called from ~46 draw paths when CmdCountSinceFlush +0x3C74 reaches CmdFlushLimit +0x3C70 and when the buffer is nearly full

name: GfxSubmitFrameCmdList
signature: u64 (CmdListRing* r, void* alloc, u8 flag)
description: closes the current command list (490D5C) and hands all pending lists to the ECL ring (4930C8); used by the present path

name: SynCloseCmdList
description: flush immediate draws if any, then close the list (490F64 -> 490D5C/4920E0); returns its fence value

name: CmdListRingClose
signature: u64 (CmdListRing* r, Allocator* a, u8 f)
description: list->ClearState(NULL) (vtbl+0x58) + Close (vtbl+0x48), assigns ++fence (+0x30), records the ECL token for it, advances the ring

name: CmdListRingFlushAndRecycle
description: submits pending lists to the ECL ring (86F760) and recycles the next list/allocator through allocator vfns +0x10/+0x18 (may wait on its fence; not examined)

name: CmdListRingSubmitUpTo
signature: u64 (CmdListRing* r, void* a, u64 fence, u8 f)
description: hands all pending closed lists up to the given fence value to the ECL ring (EclRingPush 86F760)

name: EclRingPush
signature: void (CmdListRing* r, void* a, void* tokens, u8 f)
description: pushes one item into the ExecuteCommandListsThread ring (86F828) and ReleaseSemaphore(+0x80)

name: EclRingPushItem
description: ring push; blocks (WaitForSingleObject INFINITE) when the ring is full

name: CmdListRingSubmitIfBehind
signature: void (CmdListRing* r, void* a, u64 fence, u8 f)
description: if fence > submitted: close list if needed and submit up to fence; called when descriptor/upload rings run out (118E28, 118C10, 1188AC, 495xxx)

name: SynTokDrawIndexed
description: tok 0x6A: SynFlushGfxStateForDraw then DrawIndexedInstanced(count, 1, start, 0, 0); ++c+0x548

name: SynTokDraw
description: tok 0x69: state flush then DrawInstanced

name: SynTokExecuteIndirect
description: tok 0x6F: state flush, transition the argument buffer (115E24), ExecuteIndirect

name: SynTokDispatch
description: tok 0x7E: SynFlushComputeState then Dispatch

name: SynFlushComputeState
description: compute PSO lookup/SetPipelineState (vtbl+0xC8) and SetComputeRootDescriptorTable flushes (4959EC/495414/495764)

name: SynFlushGfxStateForDraw
description: before every draw: calls SynPsoFlushFunctor (118604); if c+0xB24 & 0xF dirty: per-RT/DSV state transitions (one ResourceBarrier call each, 118443/118519/118597), OMSetRenderTargets, RSSetViewports, RSSetScissorRects

name: SynFlushPsoAndBindings
description: per draw: CBV/SRV/sampler table flushes (118DA8, 118C10, 118BA0, 1188AC), IASetPrimitiveTopology on change, PSO lookup (119670) + SetPipelineState when dirty (c+0xB24 & 0x20); 5.1 % of the dispatcher

name: SynFlushCbvTables
signature: void (SynCtx* c, void* tables, void* fence)
description: for each shader stage with dirty CBVs (+0xB70[stage]) and a non-empty table: SynFlushCbvTable 118E28

name: SynFlushCbvTable
description: per dirty CBV: upload-ring alloc (1190C0) + memcpy of the slot shadow (3rd copy of constant data) + CreateConstantBufferView (device +0x8E0 vtbl+0x88); then shader-visible ring alloc (1192B0), CopyDescriptorsSimple(whole table), SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable (was RenderSubmitHot_118E28)

name: SynFlushSrvTables
signature: void (SynCtx* c, void* tables, void* fence)
description: for each stage with SRV-table dirty bit (+0x10F0): ring alloc, CopyDescriptorsSimple(table size), SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable

name: SynDescRingAlloc
signature: i32 (DescRing* r, u32 n, void* fence, void* out)
description: allocates n descriptors in a shader-visible ring heap; negative when full (caller then submits via 945664 and retries) (was RenderSubmitHot_1192B0)

name: SynBindTextureSampler
signature: void (SynCtx* c, int stage, int slot, Texture* t, ...)
description: binds SRV+sampler to (stage, slot): skipped if both unchanged; else CopyDescriptorsSimple(1) into staging, dirty bits +0x10F0/+0x1E38, and an immediate state transition to PIXEL/NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE via 115E24 (was RenderSubmitHot_115B9C)

name: SynCopyDescriptorSimple1
signature: void (SynCtx* c, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE dst, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE src, u32 heapType)
description: device(+0x8E8)->CopyDescriptorsSimple(1, dst, src, type) (vtbl+0xC0); 2.2 % of the dispatcher

name: SynTransitionResource
signature: void (SynCtx* c, ID3D12Resource* r, u32* curState, u32 newState, u64* stamp, u32 sub)
description: state-tracked single transition: skips if *curState == newState, else ResourceBarrier(1, TRANSITION) (vtbl+0xD0); 45 callers; 4.4 % of the dispatcher; candidate B1

name: SynTokUavBarrier
description: tok 0x8A: ResourceBarrier(1, UAV, resource from token); one per particle-emitter dispatch

name: SynUavBarrier
description: ResourceBarrier(1, UAV, r)

name: SynFlushImmediateDraws
description: draws pending immediate-mode geometry (+0x2458 verts): IASetVertexBuffers + IASetIndexBuffer + DrawIndexedInstanced; called first by 88 handlers

name: SynTokSetCbData
description: tok 0x66: copies the inline constant blob into the per-slot shadow c+0xD70[slot] (2nd copy) and sets dirty bit c+0xB80

name: CmdWriteInlineBlobA
description: main thread: writes tok 0x66 (set constant-buffer slot data) + size + memcpy of the CPU constant buffer into the stream (1st copy; later copied twice more by 698EAC and 118E28)

name: SynPsoCacheLookup
description: B-tree lookup with 128-byte memcmp keys used by the PSO resolve path under 118604 (was RenderSubmitHot_119820; aka state-object cache in worker-threads.md)

name: SynTokSetVertexBuffers
description: tok 0x3C: transitions + IASetVertexBuffers (was RenderSubmitHot_116260)

name: SynTokSetIndexBuffer
description: tok 0x3D: IASetIndexBuffer + transition (was RenderSubmitHot_114A20)

name: WaitDispatcherDrainSpin_PauseSite
description: patch S1 (17 B): 88 05 32 59 1B 04 0F B6 05 2B 59 1B 04 84 C0 75 E7 -> 88 05 32 59 1B 04 84 C0 74 07 F3 90 EB EA 0F 1F 00 (adds PAUSE); verified offline by re/scripts_d3d12/drainspin_pause.fsx; not applied

name: DrawSubmit_KickThresholdCmp
description: cmp CmdCountSinceFlush, CmdFlushLimit (+0x3C74 vs +0x3C70) -> KtglCmdStreamFlush every N draws (candidate K1)

name: GfxDevicePresent_WaitPrevPresent
description: call WaitPresentThreadIdle before handing the next Present to the present thread

name: RenderFrameBegin_WaitPresentDone
description: frame-begin call of WaitPresentThreadIdle (the 1-6 % main-thread wait, candidates P1/P2)

name: PresentThread_PresentCall
description: call swapchain->Present (vtbl+0x40) on the present thread
